title: Someone is running Qwen 27B at ~20 tok/s on a jailbroken PS5's GPU
script:
A jailbroken PlayStation five is now running the Qwen twenty-seven B model.
The console achieves twenty tokens per second during inference.
This performance relies on the console's sixteen gigabytes of unified GDDR6 memory.
The project runs via native homebrew software on the existing FreeBSD operating system.
The model is compressed using two-bit quantization to fit the system requirements.
The developer specifically leveraged the PS5 GPU to handle the heavy computations.
Would you risk your console to run your own local AI?
